facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Shapeshifting: most potions and consumables work in form (Rage potions and Thistletea too; Mana Potions in form came back on 8 Oct), weapon enchants and procs work in form, form auto-attacks use your weapon's DPS, and forms have been immune to Disarm since 1 Oct.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Baseline spells include Nature's Grasp at 10 (usable in forms and indoors), Revive at 12, Omen of Clarity at 20, Feral Faerie Fire and Improved Mark of the Wild. Lacerate is a one-point Feral talent on row 4. Tiger's Fury was removed.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Bear and Dire Bear Form have a 115% threat bonus. Lacerate is now a Feral talent, while Primal Bite is a separate 31-point Bear choice.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Cats learn Poised at level 32. Start a fight from full Energy to save 10 Energy on your next Energy ability. Predatory Discipline leads to Shifting Power at 31 points.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Moonkin Aura and Leader of the Pack each improve every type of critical strike. The auras are mutually exclusive. Coordinate which one your raid uses.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Balance and Restoration: Hurricane has no cooldown, Entangling Roots works indoors, Thorns scales with spell power, Rejuvenation, Tranquility and Wild Growth can crit (24 Sep), Swiftmend no longer eats the heal over time, and a 16 Oct fix stops high-rank Rejuvenation from blocking another Druid's.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Berserk and Gift of the Earthmother were removed. Furor moves to Feral in exchange for Heart of the Wild, and Restoration gains Bloom.

facts.label: Balance talents gone since Classic 1.12
facts.value: Five Classic Balance talents are gone from the tree: Nature's Grasp, Improved Nature's Grasp, Natural Weapons, Improved Thorns and Omen of Clarity.

facts.label: Feral Combat talents gone since Classic 1.12
facts.value: Two Classic Feral Combat talents are gone from the tree: Feral Aggression and Faerie Fire (Feral).

facts.label: Restoration talents gone since Classic 1.12
facts.value: Two Classic Restoration talents are gone from the tree: Improved Mark of the Wild and Improved Enrage.

facts.label: Bear Form: 'Heeding the Call' to 'Body and Heart' (10)
facts.value: Alliance starts in Darnassus. You visit the Great Bear Spirit in Moonglade and return to your capital. Teaches Bear Form, Growl and Maul, and the Moonglade step gives Teleport: Moonglade (warcraft.wiki.gg, Method).

facts.label: Cure Poison: 'Lessons Anew' (the 'Power over Poison' chain) (14)
facts.value: Teaches Cure Poison. Alliance starts in Darnassus (warcraft.wiki.gg, Method).

facts.label: Aquatic Form: 'A Lesson to Learn' (16)
facts.value: A set of trials that ends with the 'Aquatic Form' quest (warcraft.wiki.gg, Method).

facts.label: Cat Form: 'The Great Cat Spirit' (new in Forever) (20)
facts.value: Cat Form is no longer simply trained. Recover relics from the Stormrage Barrow Den in Moonglade, then do 'Blessings of the Great Cat Spirit' and 'To Darnassus', which teaches Cat Form, Claw, Prowl and Rip (warcraft.wiki.gg, Wowhead, Method). A 16 Oct beta report said the Relic of the Fang could not be looted; no fix was confirmed.

facts.label: Skyborne Druid form quests (Unconfirmed)
facts.value: Single report (Method): Skyborne Druids start their form quests on Zephras Isle, 'The Great Ursera Spirit' for Bear and 'The Great Windborne Cat Spirit' for Cat. Other reports disagree on the NPCs and start points.

facts.label: Eclipse loop
facts.value: Eclipse: each Wrath cuts the cast time of your next 2 Starfires by 0.17, 0.33 or 0.50 sec, depending on rank. It stores up to 4 charges, and they last 15 sec.

facts.label: Damage over time: Nature's Splendor
facts.value: Nature's Splendor adds 3 sec to Moonfire and Rejuvenation, 6 sec to Regrowth and 2 sec to Insect Swarm.

facts.label: Crit chain: Nature's Grace
facts.value: Nature's Grace: after a non-periodic spell crit, your spellcasting speed rises and your global cooldown shortens by 10% for 3 sec.

facts.label: Mana: Moonglow
facts.value: Moonglow cuts the Mana cost of your damaging spells by 8%, 17% or 25% across its 3 ranks.

facts.label: Spell hit (Classic baseline for the cap)
facts.value: Nature's Reach adds hit (2% at rank 1) and range. Classic casters needed 16% spell hit against raid bosses three levels higher; Icy Veins says Forever has a cap but its value is not known yet.

facts.label: Moonkin Aura
facts.value: The critical strike bonus applies to all attacks and spells.

facts.label: Moonkin Aura with Leader of the Pack
facts.value: Only one of these auras can apply. Coordinate with the Feral Druid before setting the raid composition.

facts.label: Raid utility levels
facts.value: Rebirth 20, Remove Curse 24, Abolish Poison 26, Tranquility 30, Innervate and Hurricane 40, Gift of the Wild 50, per the warcraft.wiki.gg Forever ability table.

facts.label: World buffs
facts.value: Wowhead's Forever data marks Rallying Cry of the Dragonslayer 'No effect while in a raid instance', and warcraft.wiki.gg says world buffs are removed in dungeons and raids.

facts.label: Classic baseline
facts.value: In Classic, Balance was weak in raids and mainly brought for the party spell-crit aura.

facts.label: Potions in Moonkin Form
facts.value: Most potions and consumables work in form, and Mana Potions in form were restored on 8 Oct.

facts.label: Classic caster kit
facts.value: Flask of Supreme Power, Greater Arcane Elixir, Major Mana Potion, Mageblood Potion, wizard oils, Demonic and Dark Runes, Runn Tum Tuber Surprise, Nightfin Soup and Sagefish Delight.

facts.label: New Forever elixirs
facts.value: Warcraft Tavern reports Elixir of Cunning (Agility plus Intellect) and Minor Arcane Elixir, and says flasks are brewed at a portable Alchemy Laboratory camp object.

facts.label: Bear threat
facts.value: Bear and Dire Bear Form have a 115% threat bonus. Lacerate moves to row 4 and Primal Bite to row 7.

facts.label: Bear survival
facts.value: Thick Hide adds armor from Defense bonuses, so Defense gear now helps, and Frenzied Regeneration heals up to 100% of max health over its duration.

facts.label: Rage
facts.value: Later beta notes doubled Rage from crits.

facts.label: Cat Energy
facts.value: Predatory Discipline lets Ferocious Bite benefit from excess Energy without spending it. Take Shifting Power after it if you are building for Cat Form.

facts.label: Bleed bonus
facts.value: Rend and Tear increases damage by up to 15%. Blizzard also increased the base damage and attack-power scaling of Rip and Rake.

facts.label: Feral capstones
facts.value: Berserk was removed. Choose Primal Bite for Bear Form or Shifting Power for Cat Form.

facts.label: Leader of the Pack
facts.value: The critical strike bonus applies to spells and attacks and is exclusive with Moonkin Aura.

facts.label: Bear raid tanking
facts.note: Untested: bear threat and armor improved during beta, but no Forever raid has been tanked yet.

facts.label: Swipe: Feral Instinct
facts.value: Feral Instinct adds 10%, 20% or 30% to Swipe damage across its 3 ranks and makes you harder to detect while Prowling.

facts.label: Weapon procs in form
facts.value: Windfury Totem, Crusader and sharpening stones all work in form, and Alliance raids can now field Dwarf Shamans for Windfury Totem.

facts.label: Classic baseline
facts.value: In Classic, bears were decent raid tanks and cat damage was mid-tier.

facts.label: Melee hit cap vs raid bosses
facts.note: No Forever value has been published.

facts.label: Classic tank kit
facts.value: Flask of the Titans, Elixir of the Mongoose, Elixir of Greater Agility, Elixir of the Giants, Greater Stoneshield Potion, Juju Might, Juju Power, Winterfall Firewater and Grilled Squid.

facts.label: Flasks
facts.value: In Classic only one flask is active at a time, and it persists through death.

facts.label: Rage Potions and Thistletea
facts.value: Now usable by Druids, and most potions work in form.

facts.label: New Forever elixirs
facts.value: Warcraft Tavern reports Elixir of the Grizzly (Strength plus crit) and Elixir of Cunning (Agility plus Intellect).

facts.label: Fire resistance for Onyxia
facts.value: Blizzard tells raids to build fire resistance before Onyxia but gives no target number.

facts.label: Heal-over-time core: Improved Rejuvenation
facts.value: Improved Rejuvenation raises the effect of your Rejuvenation by 5%, 10% or 15% across its 3 ranks.

facts.label: Crits
facts.value: Rejuvenation, Tranquility and Wild Growth can crit since 24 Sep.

facts.label: Swiftmend
facts.value: Swiftmend requires your own Rejuvenation or Regrowth on the target. Blizzard confirmed it leaves that effect in place.

facts.label: Bloom
facts.value: Bloom scales with Spirit. It heals for 100% of Spirit at natural expiry and 50% when the effect is dispelled.

facts.label: Mana: Reflection
facts.value: Reflection lets 17%, 33% or 50% of your Mana regeneration continue while casting.

facts.label: Wild Growth
facts.value: The base cast time is 3 seconds. Naturalist shortens it by up to 0.5 seconds.

facts.label: Blizzard's healer intent
facts.value: Druid healing relies on heals over time that need planning, and Blizzard calls it less versatile than Priest healing.

facts.label: Several Druids together
facts.value: Warcraft Tavern argues several Restoration Druids now work well together because heals over time stack and crit; a 16 Oct fix stops high-rank Rejuvenation from blocking another Druid's.

facts.label: Utility
facts.value: Innervate (40), Rebirth (20), Remove Curse (24), Abolish Poison (26) and Tranquility (30) per the warcraft.wiki.gg Forever table.

facts.label: Classic baseline
facts.value: Restoration Druids were strong raid healers in Classic, with Innervate and Rebirth as their signature utilities.

facts.label: Classic healer kit
facts.value: Flask of Distilled Wisdom, Elixir of the Sages, Major Mana Potion, Mageblood Potion, Demonic and Dark Runes, Nightfin Soup, Runn Tum Tuber Surprise, Sagefish Delight and wizard oils.

facts.label: Forever alchemy
facts.value: Warcraft Tavern says healing potions moved from Alchemy to First Aid and flasks are brewed at a portable Alchemy Laboratory camp object.

facts.label: Camp buffs
facts.value: Warcraft Tavern: profession camp objects grant slightly weaker copies of class buffs that don't stack with the real ones, and you must sit at the camp for at least 1 minute.

facts.label: Launch raids
facts.value: Raid unlock date: 9 December 2026, for Barrow Deeps (10 players), Hyjal Summit (20) and Onyxia's Lair (40), all planned to reset weekly.
